scientific_integrity: All claims admit a self-contained Fano-incidence proof and two independent executable finite checks. Finite checks are not used as proofs of results outside the stated graph.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite theorem for the fourteen-vertex Heawood graph only; prior enumeration of twenty-one minimum dominating sets is background, not new; no generalization to higher-order projective planes. Historical-priority certification and external independent audit are outstanding.
title: The minimum-domination shattering complex of the Heawood graph
